description: This file defines the PdfBoolean class, representing a boolean value in a PDF document within the PDFsharp library. It includes predefined instances for true and false, and methods for output and string representation.

classes.name: PdfBoolean
classes.description: Represents a direct boolean value within the PDFsharp library, encapsulating true/false values and providing methods for output and string conversion.

methods.name: PdfBoolean()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a PdfBoolean object with no value assigned.

methods.name: PdfBoolean(bool value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a PdfBoolean object with a specified boolean value.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns the string 'true' or 'false' based on the boolean value.

methods.name: WriteObject(PdfWriter writer)
methods.description: Writes the PdfBoolean to an output stream using the provided PdfWriter.
